# Samaat — Hearing Aids in Pakistan

Samaat sells and fits genuine imported hearing aids across Pakistan (Lahore HQ; delivery and fitting support nationwide). Quotes are given on WhatsApp with written warranty terms; prices are confirmed against current stock because the rupee moves them.

> Samaat.pk — genuine hearing aids, transparent price bands, no fake "Rs 1,499" listings. WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923390000929
